title: Freedom from the Known
author: J Krishnamurti
description: Krishnamurti basically says your thoughts are second-hand. Drop the conditioning and actually look at life fresh. Messed with my head in a good way.

title: The 12 Week Year
author: Brian P. Moran, Michael Lennington
description: Forget yearly goals. Treat every 12 weeks like a full year and suddenly you stop procrastinating. Simple, but it works.

title: The Diary of a Young Girl
author: Anne Frank
description: A 13-year-old hiding from the Nazis for two years, still believing people are good at heart. Makes my bad days look silly.

title: Krishna: The Man and His Philosophy
author: Osho
description: Krishna as a guy who danced, loved, fought, and stayed chill through all of it. You don't need to run to the Himalayas to be spiritual.

title: The Book of Man
author: Osho
description: Osho on every role men get stuffed into. Big takeaway: Zorba the Buddha. Enjoy life fully and stay aware, no need to pick one.

title: The Book of Woman
author: Osho
description: Love, freedom, and the feminine side in all of us. Love that tries to own someone isn't love. Some takes you'll love, some you'll argue with.

title: Why I Am an Atheist and Other Works
author: Bhagat Singh
description: A 23-year-old in jail, waiting to be hanged, calmly explaining why he doesn't believe in God. Zero ego, all logic. Question everything.
